quote: Die Steuer beträgt für jeden steuerpflichtigen Umsatz 20% der Bemessungsgrundlage (§§ 4 und 5). — The tax is 20% of the taxable amount for every taxable supply.
source_title: RIS Bundesrecht konsolidiert: UStG 1994 § 10 (Fassung BGBl. I Nr. 37/2026, in force 01.07.2026)

reduced_rates.scope: basic foodstuffs listed in Annex 3 (new super-reduced rate from 2026-07-01, § 10 Abs. 1a; BGBl. I Nr. 37/2026)
foodstuffs in Annex 1 incl. restaurant food/drinks, books/newspapers, residential letting, hotel accommodation, water, waste collection, charities (§ 10 Abs. 2)

Annex 2 goods (live animals, plants, art), artists, swimming pools, theatre/concerts/museums/zoos, film shows, circus, domestic air passenger transport, wine sold by producer, sporting events (§ 10 Abs. 3)
supplies in Jungholz and Mittelberg by locally established businesses (§ 10 Abs. 4)
zero rate with deduction: contraceptives and feminine hygiene products from 2026-01-01; charitable food donations; Austrian leg of cross-border rail (per TEDB)

notes: Single national VAT; no sub-national VAT. 4.9% rate on Annex 3 foodstuffs introduced by BGBl. I Nr. 37/2026, applicable to supplies after 2026-06-30 (§ 28 Abs. 69 UStG 1994). § 28 lists no further enacted rate changes (latest amendment BGBl. I Nr. 62/2026 only touches § 26 from 2027-01-01). Exports and intra-EU supplies exempt with deduction. TEDB cross-check: 20% standard; reduced 4.9/10/13/19/0 — consistent.
unverified: valid_from 1984-01-01: start of 20% rate (increase from 18% under UStG 1972) not confirmed in an official text; current UStG 1994 (in force 1995-01-01) has carried 20% since enactment
